subject: SIG-Lite: Supplemental Subprocessor Annex and Crypto SLA Clarifications
messages:
From: Andrew Miller <security@medallionhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SIG-Lite supplemental items + subprocessor annex

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the SIG-Lite submission last week. Our InfoSec team reviewed and has two follow-ups before we can proceed to the procurement stage:

1) We need a current subprocessor annex (or a signed statement) that enumerates all cloud, monitoring, and key-management subprocessors handling PHI-derived artifacts for the Medallion integration. The annex needs explicit residency claims for each subprocessor (region/country).

2) Clarification on crypto SLA: does Redwood maintain a written SLA that covers key rotation, emergency key revocation, and recovery in the event of a compromised KMS instance? If so, please point us to the excerpt or provide a short summary and evidence.

Can you provide the annex and any artifacts (matrix or summary) by COB next Tuesday (2026-11-24)? If there are attachments coming in stages that's fine — just a short timeline and who on your team will coordinate.

Thanks,
Andrew Miller
Director, Information Security
Medallion Health

Attachments requested: subprocessor annex, crypto SLA excerpt, residency matrix
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Miller <security@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SIG-Lite supplemental items + subprocessor annex

Hi Andrew —

Appreciate the clear list. We're happy to get this over the finish line. Quick summary / plan: 

- Attached: preliminary subprocessor roster CSV (redwood_subprocessor_roster_20261123.csv) and a draft answers PDF (sig-lite-answers-preview.pdf) that addresses the SIG-Lite fields we flagged. The roster includes service role, vendor contact, and primary region of operation.

- Crypto SLA: we're preparing a one-page excerpt that describes our key rotation cadence (90 days default), emergency revocation flow (supported via our KMS provider + on-call security runbook), and recovery procedures. We will also include a sentence on customer-controlled key options (BYOK) where applicable. That will be in the crypto-residency-matrix_20261123.xlsx we plan to upload.

Next steps: Laura and Marissa are on copy here to finalize the annex and the DocuSign-ready subprocessor addendum. Laura — can you confirm whether we can commit to the residency cells shown in the sheet for the Medallion integration (US-only for monitoring, EU for backups)? Marissa — can you prepare the SLA excerpt and point to the internal runbook paragraph we can share?

We expect to have the finalized annex and a signed DocuSign link by Monday EOD (2026-11-23). If anything slips we'll let you know immediately.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: final edits for Medallion annex + quick Q on BYOK wording

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for jumping on this. Two quick asks so we can send a clean packet to Medallion tomorrow: 

1) Residency cells: In the roster I marked Monitoring -> us-west1 (US) and Backups -> eu-west1 (EU). Laura, confirm if backups are indeed EU-resident for the Medallion account (they asked explicitly). If not, we'll need the exact region string.

2) BYOK wording: Medallion may opt for customer-managed keys. Marissa, can you provide the short paragraph we can include in the annex that explains our BYOK support, the handoff steps, and whether any subprocessor will have access to plaintext? Keep it short (2-3 sentences) and include the KMS vendor name if allowable.

3) DocuSign: Laura, once the annex PDF is ready please upload to the shared Drive folder and ping me the DocuSign template ID. I can run the initial signature request.

Timeline: Laura / Marissa final by Sunday EOD (2026-11-22) so I can validate and send to the customer on Monday morning.

Connor
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Miller <security@medallionhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG-Lite: Supplemental Subprocessor Annex and Crypto SLA Clarifications

Hi Andrew —

Thanks for the patience. Per Connor's note, attached is the finalized subprocessor annex and the crypto excerpt you requested. Summary of the deliverables: 

- Subprocessor annex (DOCX/PDF): includes an enumerated roster, processing role, primary region, and residency commitments. Backups for the Medallion integration are EU-resident (eu-west-1) per our dataflow configuration; monitoring telemetry is US-resident (us-west1).

- Crypto SLA excerpt: key rotation (90-day rolling cadence), emergency revocation process (our on-call + KMS provider escalation path), and recovery path for rotated keys. We do support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via AWS KMS; when a customer opts in, Redwood and our subprocessors only receive wrapped keys and never plaintext.

Documents attached: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20261123.csv; sig-lite-answers-preview.pdf; crypto-residency-matrix_20261123.xlsx

Signing: I uploaded the annex to DocuSign and initiated a signature request. You should see a link here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-subprocessor-annex — please sign the annex and return. If you prefer, we can accept a signed scanned copy via the HubSpot deal record.

If there are any follow-ups on jurisdictional controls or additional evidence (e.g., SOC 2 control IDs mapped to subprocessors) let us know and we can forward a targeted pack.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20261123.csv (roster, columns: vendor,service_role,region,contact), sig-lite-answers-preview.pdf (answers to SIG-Lite questionnaire), crypto-residency-matrix_20261123.xlsx (matrix showing KMS residency & BYOK support)
